title: Did anyone attend a meeting in the dining room at the hotel/mansion recently?
content: Hi everyone, I'm new to this sub as found it after searching a recent weird dream/sleep paralysis/ possible old hag incident. The other night I had a vivid dream where I visited a few familiar dream locations. One of them was a version of my childhood home, however, I knew that it was now being run as a hotel and the decor was very different being Victorian with red baroque wallpaper. I was aware that a meeting was going to be taking place soon and that I needed to attend. It was being arranged by my father (although I never saw him) and I didn't have any role in it but was expected to be there. The only distinct impression I got of the meeting was that it was important as it was between two groups of people who weren't necessarily on the same side but who were coming together to create some sort of alliance or truce. For some reason they now needed to work together when previously they hadn't. I wasn't particularly interested in the meeting in the dream as I was more concerned about where my kids were. Two guests arrived: an older woman and her grown up daughter. I had the distinct impression that these guests were some of 'our' opponents who we were about to do a deal with, or now needed to work with. I had to show the daughter to her room. I walked her down a hallway with the red wallpaper and as we were walking I became distinctly aware that while she looked human she definitely wasn't, as if there was something else behind her eyes or she was spaced out somehow. At this time I didn't care I just wanted to show her to her room and get back to my kids. I was then in the meeting in a dining room which had a long dark polished wood table and again had the red wallpaper. I don't know what was said but throughout it I was aware of the older woman watching me and assessing me. After the meeting I was in my bed in the hotel and trying to sleep. However, I became aware of the older woman standing at the bottom of the bed and watching me. At the time I found this annoying as I just wanted to sleep and she shouldn't be there. I closed my eyes and hoped she would leave. However, she then picked up the corner of the cover and let it drop. The thing is I *felt* this happen. This then made me more fully aware that I was sleeping and that it was a dream. Again I was annoyed with this woman and just wanted her to go away. She picked up the corner of the covers again but much higher this time and brought them down violently. Again I definitely felt this and with the shock I was back in my bed but had sleep paralysis and couldn't open my eyes. It was so unusual that I then did some internet searches on sleep paralysis. I had heard of the old hag before but this woman didn't seem to fit the description. I then came across this sub and some of the mall artwork is familiar but what really got me were the posts about the hotel / mansion with the red wallpaper and dark polished wood (the pictures gave me a shock). Some people even said the old hag haunted it? So I'm curious and thought I would ask: 1. Did anyone else attend that meeting? 2. Has the old hag appeared younger before (maybe in her 60s or 70s rather than crone-like)? Has anyone encountered a daughter? 3. Has anyone else gotten sleep paralysis from visits to Mall World or felt something physically as a result of being there? Thanks for taking the time to read this!
